scope: Same-name inventory reconciliation after fresh Paper extraction and implementation. This does not establish API, behavior, variant, or visual parity with Studio.
paperEvidence: Live Paper inventory and static specimen exports captured on 29 October 2026 in paper-inventory.json and paper-migration-samples.json. Historical Studio implementation was not copied.
cautions: NotesPanel has four Paper review directions; its final visual direction is not frozen.
MinorRateMatrix is absent from the captured live Paper inventory and this package. Keep it separate from the major-unit RateMatrix.
RecordPreviewPanel, RecordPreviewSection and Sheet are compatibility surfaces. Prefer full pages for new long record workflows.
Email delivery, attachment uploads, persistence, authorization, navigation guards and application business rules belong to the consuming application.

items.name: Checkbox
items.purpose: 18px checkbox (pink when checked/indeterminate) with optional label and description.

items.name: RadioGroup
items.purpose: Single choice from a short, always-visible list of options, each with optional description.

items.name: Switch
items.purpose: On/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately.

items.name: Avatar
items.purpose: Rounded person/entity photo or initials with load-error fallback. Default sm26; chip24/radius6 is compact rounded media for Kanban assignees. Existing sizes and tones remain unchanged.

items.name: StatusChip
items.purpose: 28px status pill with tone colours and a leading dot (success, warning, danger, info, neutral).

items.name: Tag
items.purpose: 24px soft-rect label chip for categories and attributes, with optional icon and removable ×.

items.name: CountBadge
items.purpose: 18px mono count (10.5px) with optional selected/danger tone and max overflow (99+).

items.name: IdChip
items.purpose: Mono record reference chip with bookmark icon and copy-to-clipboard button (announces "Copied").

items.name: Tooltip
items.purpose: Dark hover/focus tooltip (12px) around a single focusable trigger. Includes its own provider (300ms delay).

items.name: Kbd
items.purpose: Keyboard key / shortcut hint (mono 10.5px, muted key cap).

items.name: Spinner
items.purpose: Rotating loader arc or refresh arrow in currentColor for indeterminate short waits.

items.name: Skeleton
items.purpose: Shimmering placeholder block or text lines for loading content (aria-hidden).

items.name: Meter
items.purpose: 4px usage bar (pink accent default, on a pink-tinted track; other tones on a neutral track) with optional label and value text; role=meter.

items.name: TextLink
items.purpose: Inline teal link, underline on hover; external opens a new tab with an external-link icon.

items.name: Divider
items.purpose: 1px hairline separator, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: HeadingLevelProvider
items.purpose: Sets the heading level that section components (FormSection) use inside a surface. Modal and Sheet already provide 3 because their title is the h2; useHeadingLevel() reads it.

items.name: Stack
items.purpose: Flex layout for a few children inside a region: column (default) or row, gap from the space scale (--pt-space-*), align, justify, wrap; renders div, ul or ol. Classes only, no inline styles.

items.name: VisuallyHidden
items.purpose: Deprecated compatibility for frozen historical previews. For new work use a semantic element with the public pt-visually-hidden utility class. Screen-reader-only text (.pt-visually-hidden): a 1px clipped box anchored to its containing block's top-left, so hidd

items.name: AppShell
items.purpose: The Paryatech application frame: sidebar card (brand, notes strip, module navigation, credits, collapse) + workspace card (topbar with back, breadcrumbs, search, help, notifications, account; scrolling page content). Below 1000px the sidebar becomes a drawer o

items.name: Sidebar
items.purpose: App sidebar with grouped navigation and collapsible child destinations: active parent is pink, selected child has a teal outline. Parent navigation and disclosure are separate. Open records start collapsed at the bottom above the footer; navigation scrolls ind

items.name: Topbar
items.purpose: The 57px workspace topbar AppShell renders: [menu on mobile] [back] breadcrumbs … search trigger (Ctrl/⌘ K), help, notifications bell, account menu. Exported for completeness.

items.name: Breadcrumbs
items.purpose: "CRM › Vendors" trail in the topbar: 13.5px, links secondary, current page 600 with aria-current=page. When the trail does not fit, crumbs collapse from the front into a "…" button whose menu lists (and navigates to) the hidden crumbs; the parent goes before t

items.name: BackButton
items.purpose: 36px bordered chevron-left button left of the breadcrumbs on record, detail and create pages.

items.name: NotesStrip
items.purpose: Sidebar strip (38px) that opens the module/record notes panel, with a "+" to write a note and an optional count.

items.name: NotesPanel
items.purpose: Workspace notes preserve the AppShell navigation and page context. Four review directions: top composer, thread with linked-record rail, grouped days, and dense rows. Final direction is not frozen.

items.name: CreditsMeter
items.purpose: Sidebar credit usage as a clamped percentage and usage bar beside an accessible primary plus icon upgrade control on the same row. Collapsed rail puts usage in its tooltip.

items.name: AccountMenu
items.purpose: Topbar account button (avatar + chevron, pink border) and launcher menu, built on Menu: identity header (Menu `header`: avatar, name, subtitle) above rich rows with a trailing chevron; destructive "Sign out" always last. Optional third header line (`meta`, e.g

items.name: NotificationsPanel
items.purpose: Notification center body: Unread/All filter, Mark all as read, items (title, body, "Mentions · 12 min ago" meta, unread tint) and footer links. AppShell shows it in a 480px popover from the bell.

items.name: TabBar
items.purpose: Underlined tab row with counts ("Vendors 12 | Services 11"). Optional showZeroCounts preserves explicit zero counts for filtered lists; otherwise zero and omitted counts are hidden. primary 44px/13.5px for page and record sections; secondary 40px/12.5px with i

items.name: Pagination
items.purpose: 30px mono pager: previous/next chevrons, pages with ellipses (1 … 4 5 6 … 20), pink current page with aria-current=page.

items.name: OpenRecordsList
items.purpose: The member's open records inside the sidebar card (AppShell `openRecords`): DS nav-item rows (type icon + title; × on hover; orange dot for unsaved work), a collapsible header (chevron · title · count · ⋯ Show all / Close others / Reopen / Close all), drag and

items.name: OpenRecordsSwitcher
items.purpose: Small screens (< 1000px): a topbar button with the open-record count that opens a Modal of open records (56px rows, the module page first, Find and open a record, Close all). Hidden at desktop widths.

items.name: NotificationsDrawer
items.purpose: The agency notifications inbox in a viewport-capped Drawer (scrim, focus trapped, Esc/scrim close): title/count, optional permitted-module TabBar, then legacy All/Unread or optional All/Mine, scoped Mark all as read and icon Filters (+ chips). Fixed controls a

items.name: NotificationRow
items.purpose: One compact notification row: unread dot, actor avatar or toned tile, sentence and time on one headline, one context line, record title/reason and stable footer actions. Clipped copy is available in a tooltip and the full spoken name includes context. Hover/fo

items.name: ListPageTemplate
items.purpose: List page layout: PageHeader → 12 → (inline feedback → 12) → TabBar → 0 → sub-tab row → 16 → ListToolbar → 16 → DataTable (bled to the workspace edges), with BulkActionBar + TableFooter docked sticky at the bottom. Owns every gap. Page mode keeps pagination in

items.name: RecordPageTemplate
items.purpose: Record detail layout: RecordHeader → 12 → (inline feedback) → TabBar → 20 → labelled tab body. Nested lists (DataTable, TableFooter) in the body bleed like a list page; nothing in the template clips overflow, so a direct-child `<TableFooter sticky />` stays pi

items.name: RecordOverviewLayout
items.purpose: Overview tab body: KpiStrip (full width, rules bled to the workspace edges) → 20 → [main 2fr | rail 320–360px]; the rail stacks under 1000px workspace width.

items.name: FormPageTemplate
items.purpose: Create page: 64px raised header band with PageHeader, optional inline feedback (gutter strip under the band), edge-to-edge FormSections, sticky FormFooter (Cancel, primary Create). Optional onSubmit wraps sections + footer in a <form>.

items.name: SettingsPageTemplate
items.purpose: Settings layout: PageHeader → 20 → [240px section nav (icon tile + label + description, active = pink selected) | content]. Nav becomes a horizontal row under 760px.

items.name: DashboardPageTemplate
items.purpose: Dashboard layout: PageHeader → 16 → KPI KpiStrip (bled) → 20 → [main 2fr | rail 1fr], stacked under 1000px.
